Name: Anime Robin Portrait - Robin Romance Support
Author: coldazrael
Description:
[b]Want more portraits by OhoDavi?
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Click Here[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

Note : There is currently a bug possibility on Robin Romance Mod, which is misplaced portrait expressions. It's highly recommended to keep TemporalBugFix config set to 'true' all times until an official fix has been made on the Robin Romance Mod.

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the required mods (Content Patcher, Robin Romance Mod)
[*]Download this mod
[*]Drop/Extract the folder inside the .zip to /Stardew Valley/Mods folder
[/list]
[b]Config Options :[/b]
[list]
[*][i]EnableMod[/i]
Master config to turn on and turn off the mod, the values are "true" or "false". The default is "true".[*][i]TemporalBugFix[/i]
Config that employs a temporary bug fix of misplaced portrait that possibly might be a bug on Robin Romance Mod, the values are "true" or "false". The default is "true".[/list]
